scope_manifest.instruction_title: 序境 / LUMENIS｜M 总控执行增补：单业务窗口闭环 + F 前端独立并行 + 零新增付费
direct_quotes: 采用以下模式：M 总控 + F 前端独立窗口 + C1–C6 中一个当前执行窗口。
本指令直接解除对 M、F 及 M 依照既有完整任务选择的一个业务窗口的相关停工限制。其他业务窗口不因本指令自动恢复。
优先复用已建立的可编辑 Figma 成果；免费条件不满足时，立即采用可行的零新增成本设计与实现路径，持续推进前端成果。
当前已经批准的 44 屏及官网完整设计范围保留，但不再要求所有 Figma 页面先完成，才能开始修复已有 Flutter 用户交互。
M 根据现有 Owner、Goal、派工账本及真实依赖执行顺序切换；不重复请求普通、既有授权的研发许可。
scope_manifest.design_scope: existing 44 App screens, Website families and approved four surfaces; editable design, real interaction, Chinese/English/Korean and accessibility
supersedes_scheduling_or_tool_prerequisi: global pause for M, F and the one M-selected business window
mandatory completion of all Figma design before Flutter interaction repairs
scope_manifest.semantic_machine_change_authorized: existing contract only: serial business dispatch, independent F, zero additional paid-resource envelope; no model-routing or product semantics changes

constraints: zero newly paid resources, accounts, subscriptions, seats, GPU or recurring infrastructure
preserve all existing R01-R15, J1-J8, U01-U25 and complete Owner Goals
preserve manual model, effort, service tier, account and security settings
existing owner and W6 shared-region reservation boundaries remain mandatory
ELIGIBLE and DISPATCHED do not prove RUNNING; fresh admission and actual execution are required
editable Flutter source is not a native Figma file; screenshots, PNG or PPT are not complete editable design delivery
existing Permission, Evidence, Canonical, Effect Fence, Source rights and three gate tiers remain enforced
no automatic second backend window on a dependency; freeze and hand off the existing business slot
bounded commits do not prove JOB_CLOSED, release or user acceptance
